heal.name: Heal
heal.description: Heals a wounded friendly unit for 55. Cast automatically.

slow.name: Slow
slow.description: Halves an enemy unit's speed and attack speed for 10 seconds.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.description: Hurls a fireball that explodes for 35 damage in an area.

dark_frenzy.name: Dark Frenzy
dark_frenzy.description: Drives nearby allies into a frenzy: +35% attack speed for 10 seconds.
